statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-11856: after libcurl completes a transfer to one HTTP origin with Digest authentication, a second transfer on the same handle to a different origin is sent the Authorization header meant for the first. It affects curl 7.10.6 through 8.20.0 and is fixed in 8.21.0 (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-11856.html) by https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/5c6b4880357ab3e72967c1c45cae0f96ffabc535 (digest: flush state on origin or credential change), which adds origin and creds members to libcurl's digestdata structure. DHI curl for Alpine 3.23 is built from Alpine's main/curl recipe (https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/3.23-stable/main/curl/APKBUILD) and each build carries the upstream curl release named by its version, as the libcurl/X.Y.Z version string in libcurl.so shows. We read the debug information in curl-dbg for every published build for Alpine 3.23 (8.17.0-r1 to the current 8.23.0-r1, x86_64 and aarch64): the builds from 8.17.0-r1 to 8.20.0-r1 carry libcurl 8.20.0 or older and its digestdata has no origin or creds member; from 8.21.0-r0 on, libcurl is 8.21.0 or later and digestdata has both. The range ends at 8.21.0-r0, the first build with the fix.
